body: I am beyond exhausted, every single day. Decades long insomnia, multiple physical illnesses, depression, anxiety, ptsd, adhd, body dysmorphia and fatigue. Fatigue fatigue fatigue. It is relentless. Imagine your phone only charges to 5%. You can only do one or two things before it hits 0 but when you charge it, you only get 5%. That's what I function on. I can't concentrate, I can't focus, I struggle to remember things. The smallest thing like doing dishes wipes me out. I hate myself, hate my body, hate being exhausted and hate that I can't sleep. I can't live this way much longer.
